Athletics for All Abilities!

Athletes of all para and intellectual abilities are welcome at Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track. 

No matter your experience or ability, come along and give athletics a go!

📅 Starts Friday 23 October
⏰ 4:00–5:00pm
📍 Ngā Puna Wai Athletics Track
👟 Primary & Secondary School children
💰 $5 per session or $25 for 6 sessions

The programme runs through Term 4 and continues into Term 1.

Register via the link: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=ZgaZvm_VaUC1OGDtOJJgn6VUdh5srt9NqBumf3kgjZFUQTdTTUw1RzVRS1lIVFNGUFU3VEEzMjJNOS4u

or email Chloe.Roberts@athleticscanterbury.org.nz

Everyone is welcome!

What a morning 🌅🏃‍♀️. The NCAN U16 girls team and The Good Trot social teams are underway at the Athletics Canterbury Road Relay Champs and have reached the top. Best wishes to all the teams out there. Special mention to the NCAN U12 team who're also running but turn around before the hill ⛰️

Thank you to Athletics Canterbury, the officials and volunteers who make these events happen.

We're preparing for our North Canterbury Children's Athletics open days on Tuesdays October 6th and 13th.  Following these are open athletics training sessions for new and returning teen, senior and masters athletes.  With Canterbury Interclub competition starting 17th October, Secondary Schools Champs on 5th December, Oceania Masters in late January, there is something for everyone.  Pop  down from 6pm, introduce yourself to our coaches and check it out.

sharedPost.text: Open day is coming up! We welcome all new, old and existing members to come and train on our open nights, see if it fits, see if you enjoy it. No sign up required. We ask parents to stick around to learn what its all about and hear the talk from our manager. We also welcome parents to help out, however they can. We look forward to seeing you there!
